title: @c15t/vue: Vue and Nuxt cookie banner and cookie consent management
description: Cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center for Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 and 4, with consent policies you set by location, such as GDPR opt-in or CCPA opt-out. One package gives you a Vue plugin and a Nuxt module, with composables when you want your own design.
features: A Nuxt module: add `c15t/vue` to `modules` and the server resolves each visitor's policy, so the banner is in the first HTML
A Vue plugin for Vite apps, with `consentManifest()` to bundle your policy at build time
Prebuilt cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center with a theme system
Composables for a fully custom design
Analytics, ads, and pixels follow each visitor's choice through @c15t/integrations: Google Tag Manager, Google Consent Mode v2, GA4, Meta Pixel, PostHog, and more
IAB TCF 2.4 banner and dialog components
prerequisites: Vue 3.5 or later, or Nuxt 3 or 4
An [Inth project](https://inth.com) (free sign-up), a [self-hosted backend](https://c15t.com/docs/self-host/quickstart), or offline mode for local development
manualInstallation: The `c15t` package re-exports this package at `c15t/vue`, and the docs use that path. To install this package on its own, run `pnpm add @c15t/vue` and import from `@c15t/vue` instead.
usage: **Nuxt**: register the module and set `NUXT_PUBLIC_C15T_BACKEND_URL` to your Inth backend URL
Add `ConsentRoot` and a link that opens the preference dialog to `app.vue`
**Vue with Vite**: install the plugin with `app.use(c15tVue, { mode: hosted() })` from `c15t/vue/vue-plugin`, and render `ConsentRoot` in `App.vue`
For the full setup, see the [Nuxt quickstart](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/nuxt/quickstart) or the [Vue quickstart](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/vue/quickstart)
